QUOTE: `private_access.h:14-18` gates the two branches on it: if it is undefined, `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(m)` becomes `private_##m`; if it is defined, it becomes plain `m`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the default rename to private_<member> and that defining MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS makes it expand to the plain member name.
